text:
Kai: Heads-up: Prospect SparrowShore wants a 7-day POC. They plan to test their in-house model 'SparrowShore-30B-ft' (customer-supplied) in two runtime configs: fp16 (for latency) and 4-bit per-channel quant (for cost). They want Dedicated + VPC peering and token-level billing. Can SE/infra/sec triage compatibility + blockers?

Lena: Do we have the repo/manifest? Tokenizer type? Any custom embedding layers or extra output heads?

Kai: Repo link in deal ticket: https://git.example/sparrowshore/ss-30b tag prod-2026-03. Tokenizer: HuggingFace BPE with tokenizer.json + merges.txt. Model artifacts are PyTorch: checkpoint shards and a custom head for retrieval post-processing. They claim commercial ok but license file says "proprietary/research" 126.

Diego: Quick plan: clone, run tokenizer sanity, run a trimmed forward on our runtime shim. Also inspect config for attention type (rotary vs ALiBi). Commands I'm running now:

```
git clone https://git.example/sparrowshore/ss-30b /tmp/ss30
python tools/check_tokenizer.py --path /tmp/ss30 --prompt "Hello"
python tools/runtime_probe.py --model /tmp/ss30 --dtype fp16 --seq 256 --batch 1
```

presales-bot: ticket PS-12019 created: "SparrowShore-30B POC compatibility" assigned to @diego, watchers: @lena, @harpreet, @kai.

Diego: Tokenizer loaded but uses a custom post-normalizer that strips punctuation in a specific way; I added a mapping layer in the shim. Forward pass failed in KV cache reshape: runtime expects (num_heads, seq_len, head_dim) but checkpoint uses grouped layout (num_groups, seq_len, heads_per_group, head_dim). We can reshape but need to confirm attention grouping semantics. Opening a tiny adapter PR to handle grouped heads and preserve attention masks.

Harpreet: From infra sizing: 30B dense FP16 -> recommended 3xA100-80GB if they want decent throughput; quantized 4-bit per-channel might fit on 2xA100 with model-parallel sharding. POC preview cost estimate for 7 days at ~150k tokens/day: ~$5.2k USD (infra + ops). SE hours for quantization + eval ~16h.

Lena: Security/legal: LICENSE.txt flagged as "proprietary - research only". That blocks us hosting in cloud. Options: 1) ask customer for a short POC hosting license, 2) run POC on their VPC/on-prem with our SEs (higher fees), or 3) run inference-only in their environment via ephemeral agent. I've asked legal to draft a one-week hosting waiver template. Also need their SOC2 summary and target CIDR for peering.

Diego: PR opened: internal/patches#709 1 - adapter flattens grouped heads -> (num_heads, seq, head_dim) and hooks tokenizer post-normalizer. FP16 smoke runs succeeded on tiny eval. Next step: run per-channel 4-bit quant pipeline and validate logits drift vs FP16.

Harpreet: Note: our 4-bit quant pipeline currently supports per-tensor scale and per-channel asymmetric scales; per-channel quant for grouped heads needs extra validation. Expect extra 6-8 hours to validate numeric parity and generate quality report.

Lena: SQA checklist uploaded to ticket. I've added items: key rotation during peering, minimal retention windows, endpoint logging policy, and decision matrix for hosting waiver. Sent licensing waiver draft to customer legal requesting signature for hosting during POC.

Kai: Action items: Diego -> finish quant run + quality diff report; Harpreet -> finalize provisional Dedicated pool config + cost sheet; Lena -> legal waiver + SQA follow-up. Can we have a readiness update by tomorrow 11:00 PT?

Diego: Starting quant conversions now. Commands: 
```
python quantize.py --model-dir /tmp/ss30 --method per_channel --out /tmp/ss30_q4
python eval_compare.py --fp16 /tmp/ss30 --q4 /tmp/ss30_q4 --dataset ./eval/smoke.json
```

presales-bot: note: watchlist updated, pinging @legal for waiver.

Harpreet: Provisioned preview pool id d-poc-ss-73 (2xA100-80GB). Will scale to 3xA100 if throughput requires. Posted cost sheet in ticket.

Lena: Customer legal replied: they can sign a temporary hosting addendum for the POC but will not allow distribution beyond SparrowShore. Looks OK but legal needs to review waiver. Licensing no longer a hard-block pending signed doc.

Diego: Quant run done. Observed small logit shifts: median perplexity delta ~1.8% vs FP16; top-k overlap 95% on the smoke set. Posting full QC csv in ticket and opening tests for longer eval. 4-bit stability looks promising but we'll run the 7-day eval to be sure.

Kai: Great. If waiver signed, proceed with 4-bit conversion and POC. If not, offer on-prem run. Check-in tomorrow 11:00 PT. :calendar:
